observations: The MDP page defines S, A, conditional T(s′|s,a), immediate R(s,a,s′), discount gamma and policy pi(a|s). Transitions may be deterministic or stochastic. Current state and chosen action suffice for the next-state distribution; gamma near zero emphasizes immediate rewards and near one increases future weighting.

limits: This is a source-to-current-question coverage challenge, not a renewed blind correctness review or an assurance of full-course completion. Shared examples and explanations can contextualize a tested concept; arbitrary name/count memorization is not inflated into independent concepts.
